name: nametag
description: Gives each new session a random prompt bar color and an automatic name, renames it from the conversation with /nametag, and leaves names written by hand alone.

naming_rules.title: Naming rules
naming_rules.description: How a session name is written: its language, length and style. Applies to automatic names and to /nametag. Leave empty for no rules beyond one line of plain text.
naming_rules.default: Write the name in the language the person writes in. Judge that from their own words alone: pasted code, logs, file names, command output and replies addressed to them don't count, and neither does the language of these instructions. Make it a bare noun phrase of the subject and the work: at most 15 characters in Japanese, or 4 words in English. Drop particles, modifiers, and explanation. Keep proper nouns and technical terms as written, but cut long ones down to the part that identifies them.
